question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Back to square one

options.text: To hope something happens the way you want it to
Having to start all over again

solution:
The correct answer is **"Having to start all over again."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"back to square one"** means having to start all over again from the beginning. (शुरू से ही सब कुछ फिर से शुरू करना होगा)

 
 
• **Example**: *We got a phone call from the lawyers and it was **back to square one**__.*
 
 
 
• This phrase is often used to describe a situation where progress has been lost and one must start from the beginning.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
